newsitem.title: USA: Electromagnetic begins LXE exchange offer.
newsitem.headline: Electromagnetic begins LXE exchange offer.

text.p: Electromagnetic Sciences Inc said on Wednesday that it has launched an offer to exchange 0.75 share of its common stock for each share of LXE Inc that Electromagnetic does not already own.
Electromagnetic now owns 81.5 percent of LXE shares and wants the 1,030,000 shares held by other investors, the company said.
The deal is subject to approval by Electromagnetic Sciences shareholders, who will vote on the matter at a special meeting on December 30, 1996.

If Electromagnetic increases its ownership to at least 90 percent it could merge with LXE, in which case each LXE holder would receive 0.75 of an Electromagnetic share for each LXE share, the company said.
The offer expires on December 30, 1996 at midnight.
